design: Run the original activity classifier first. Only PHONE proposals receive three tight chronological crops from the same anonymous track. Accept PHONE only when Qwen confirms target-owned active handset use in at least two crops; otherwise reclassify without PHONE.
limitations: The four cases were selected from previously observed errors and are not held out.
The full video still requires reviewer inspection for regressions.
Phone verification adds approximately 0.7 to 1.24 seconds only to PHONE proposals and requires a temporal evidence buffer.
